title: Kong and CTC expand Japan distribution through AWS Marketplace
summary: Kong Japan and Itochu Techno-Solutions (CTC) formed a channel partnership to resell Kong API and AI connectivity products through AWS Marketplace private offers, combining CTC's enterprise customer base and cloud integration capabilities with Kong's platform.
confirmed: Kong Japan and CTC announced a partner agreement aimed at expanding sales of Kong API and AI products in Japan.
CTC will resell eligible Kong products through AWS Marketplace Channel Partner Private Offers, allowing customer-specific pricing and contract terms.
The companies plan joint proposals and implementation support using CTC's enterprise customer base and cloud expertise.
uncertain: Neither company disclosed bookings, contract value, revenue contribution, customer count or adoption.
The announcement does not confirm company-wide ARR, margins, cash flow, dilution or an IPO filing or timetable.
